title.zh: Redmi K30 Pro / POCO F2 Pro postmarketOS 移植
title.en: Redmi K30 Pro / POCO F2 Pro postmarketOS Port

zh: 为 Redmi K30 Pro / POCO F2 Pro（lmi，SM8250 / Snapdragon 865）整理 postmarketOS / Linux 移植项目，维护 downstream LineageOS 4.19 与 mainline/copydown 两条版本线。
完成 kernel、DTB 与完整镜像构建；在真实硬件上验证 downstream v27 持久化启动、rootfs 挂载、正常 userspace、SSH 与 Windows RNDIS USB networking。
推进 downstream Wi-Fi bring-up：D-v43 已验证 wlan0 / p2p0 / wifi-aware0 出现并可扫描；最新 downstream artifact 为 D-v46，mainline/copydown 记录至 M-r7 但尚未 boot-verified。
en: Maintained a postmarketOS / Linux port for Redmi K30 Pro / POCO F2 Pro (lmi, SM8250 / Snapdragon 865), tracking both downstream LineageOS 4.19 and mainline/copydown version lines.
Built kernel, DTBs, and full images; verified downstream v27 persistent boot, rootfs mounting, normal userspace, SSH, and Windows RNDIS USB networking on real hardware.

Advanced downstream Wi-Fi bring-up: D-v43 verifies wlan0 / p2p0 / wifi-aware0 and successful scans; latest downstream artifact is D-v46, while mainline/copydown is recorded through M-r7 but not yet boot-verified.

title.zh: Markra - WYSIWYG Markdown 编辑器贡献

zh: 提交并关闭滚动位置丢失问题 #226，合并修复 PR #227，使 visual / source 编辑模式切换时保留滚动进度。
合并 PR #402，为表格加入列宽模式设置：默认等宽、可选择自动列宽，并保留文档级 toolbar 覆盖。
补充多表格场景测试、设置页覆盖和多语言文案，贡献于本地优先、支持原生 AI 的 WYSIWYG Markdown 编辑器。
en: Filed and closed scroll-loss issue #226, then merged PR #227 to preserve scroll progress when switching between visual and source editor modes.
Merged PR #402 to add table column width mode settings: even by default, auto as an opt-in mode, with document-level toolbar overrides preserved.
Added focused multi-table tests, settings coverage, and localized copy for a local-first WYSIWYG Markdown editor with native AI.
